Clad (YC W23) | Software Engineer | NYC | withclad.com

Clad is software for building physical infrastructure. We help contractors automate their back office so they can scale their business.

We're a 7 person team in person in NYC, raised $2.7M, have >4 years of runway, and are growing faster than we ever have in the history of the company.

You'll build a well-crafted product, and work on challenging problems at intersection of AI, construction (mapping), and fintech.

Apply here: https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/clad/jobs/YHGyRSf-full...

Or email me at jason [at] withclad [dot] com
